independent_units: Two chronological traces with no independent specimen identifiers; nonoverlapping temporal blocks are scoring units, not independent specimens. All trace linkage is explicit.
limitations: Curator-only: original acquisition files contain historical responses; never grant source-root access to discovery agents
Outputs omit test responses and do not create an evaluator vault
Corrected partitions require new scientific admission and a new frozen comparison

policy.blocks: min(4,floor((k-3)*5/(N-3))) using zero-based numeric-row index k
policy.calibration: Mean first three finite currents; time origin is third corresponding observation
policy.sample_selection: All subsequent finite numeric rows in acquisition order
policy.split: blocks 0,1,2 train; block 3 dev; block 4 test, separately per trace

reference_parser_provenance.reuse: Measurement and identity specification reimplemented; no fitting, reference equations, fitted states or confirmation evaluator copied
